# Deploy Axiom

> Deploy Axiom builds and runs AI agents for owner-led firms, so nothing in the business waits on the owner to remember it. Based in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. Founder: P. K. Stewart. Company: Deploy Axiom LLC.

## For AI agents

For AI agents: an MCP server at https://axiom-front-door.percyhendrux123.workers.dev/mcp answers from https://deployaxiom.com/facts/, word for word. It can also pass a call request or a question to P. K. Stewart, who answers each one yes or no.

## Who it is for

Owner-led firms where everything waits on the owner: insurance agencies, law offices, financial advisors and CPAs, real estate teams, medical and dental practices, coaches and fitness studios, and founders' offices.

## What it does

- The agents handle a business's client care, follow-up and records.
- They read, sort, draft, edit and check the result.
- Anything that sends, publishes, spends or alters a customer record is prepared in full, then held for the owner's yes.
- Moving money, setting prices and making commitments in the owner's name stay with the owner. An agent never completes a payment.
- The agents run on the owner's own computer and accounts, not Deploy Axiom's.

## How to start

- Book a 15-minute call: https://calendar.app.google/rD42RF3YVLaRV52J6
- Write a short brief on the homepage: https://deployaxiom.com/#contact
- Email: percy@deployaxiom.com
- Pricing: the scope, price, schedule and deliverables of each engagement are set in a written proposal, invoice or agreement. See https://deployaxiom.com/terms/

- [Baton Rouge](https://deployaxiom.com/baton-rouge/): an AI receptionist for Baton Rouge businesses that starts with leads and missed calls.
- [Free AI help, Baton Rouge](https://deployaxiom.com/baton-rouge/free-ai-help/): free, in-person AI help for three independently owned Baton Rouge small businesses, through December 31. One task, one 90-minute session, one 30-minute check-in.
- [Insurance field report](https://deployaxiom.com/field-reports/insurance-client-care/): client care for an independent insurance agency, including what is not proven yet.
- [Plugins](https://deployaxiom.com/plugins/): six plugins Deploy Axiom runs on its own agents, accepted into the Hermes Agent plugin catalog. Public code for technical reviewers.
- [Operator layer](https://deployaxiom.com/operator-layer/): how the whole system works for a founder.
